messages:
Alex K: quick ping to infra — can someone take a look at PR #4821? It wires the new GPU pool subnets into the internal routing (touches terraform modules and route tables). Need to merge before Friday's deploy. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/4821
Devon: :eyes: on it, will skim now
infra-ci: infra-ci: plan succeeded for refs/pull/4821/head — no diffs against staging (automated)
Devon: high level looks ok. main worry: the route_table_association change might break egress for mgmt instances in that subnet — left an inline comment
Alex K: noted — the route only adds 10.0.8.0/24 -> gpu-nat-gw, we kept the fallback route. snippet: ```terraform
resource "aws_route" "gpu_to_nat" {
  cidr_block = "10.0.8.0/24"
  gateway_id = aws_nat_gateway.gpu.id
}
```
Cheng: @Devon @Sasha I can double-check HA impact. Which AZs are the GPU nodes in?
Devon: AZs a,b,c (spread). Also left a note about NLB health-check timeout config — might need 10s instead of 5s
Sasha: I'll run a quick connectivity sim, but LGTM pending Cheng's check. :+1:
Olivia: if this lands before Friday, please add a one-line to release notes and update infra runbook (gpu-pools section)
Alex K: will update runbook and release notes. @infra-ci can we trigger a canary deploy once merged?
infra-ci: infra-ci: canary pipeline triggers on merge to main with tag `canary/gpu-route`. Please add label `canary-ok` to PR to run canary.
Alex K: added label `canary-ok`. @Cheng any blockers?
Cheng: no blockers. tiny nit: add `depends_on = [aws_nat_gateway.gpu]` to the route to ensure ordering. otherwise LGTM :thumbsup:
Devon: approving now. @Alex K please squash the formatting fix from my comment
Alex K: squashed and pushed. thanks all — i'll merge in ~30m unless any objections
Sasha: will monitor canary once it runs and ping if metrics spike
Olivia: thanks team — tagging docs task in the PR for the runbook update
Alex K: merged. infra-ci: infra-ci: canary pipeline started for ref main@{merge} with tag canary/gpu-route
Devon: nice, thanks Alex!
